meaning: The latest time or date by which something must be finished.
ex: Is the end of March still a firm deadline for you?

meaning: A situation in which something happens later than planned.
ex: We're sorry for the delay in sending you the updated build.

meaning: To say that you are sorry for something you did or that happened.
ex: I'd like to apologize for missing yesterday's call.

meaning: To say or show that something is true, correct or definitely agreed.
ex: Could you confirm that Friday works for the demo?

meaning: An area of the world that uses the same standard time.
ex: Since we're in a different time zone, could we meet at 9 a.m. your time?

meaning: To turn off the sound of your microphone during a call.
ex: Sorry, I think you're on mute — we can't hear you.

meaning: An idea or plan that you offer for someone to consider.
ex: Thanks for the suggestion; we'll add it to the next sprint plan.

meaning: A problem or subject that people need to discuss or deal with.
ex: We found the issue you reported and a fix is on the way.

meaning: An amount taken off the usual price.
ex: We can offer a small discount if you sign the annual contract.

meaning: Used to say that something is sad, disappointing or not what you wanted.
ex: We tested it again, but unfortunately the issue still happens on Safari.

meaning: As quickly as you can; without unnecessary delay.
ex: We'll send you the revised quote as soon as possible.

meaning: A schedule that shows your meetings and appointments.
ex: I've just sent an invite to your calendar for Thursday.

meaning: Movement toward finishing or improving something.
ex: Let me give you a quick update on our progress this week.

meaning: To start or continue doing something, often after getting permission.
vi: cứ tiếp tục, cứ làm đi
ex: Please go ahead — I'll share my questions after you finish.

meaning: To make something easier to understand by explaining it in more detail.
ex: Could you clarify what you mean by real-time updates?

meaning: Something that a customer needs or asks for in a product.
ex: Is offline access a requirement for the first version?

meaning: A presentation that shows how a product or feature works.
ex: We'll do a short demo of the new checkout flow at the end of the call.

meaning: Comments or opinions about how good or useful something is.
ex: Do you have any feedback on the designs we sent last week?

meaning: A judgment of how much time or money something will probably need.
ex: Our estimate for this feature is about three weeks.

meaning: A plan that shows when each part of a project will happen.
vi: lộ trình thời gian, tiến độ
ex: Here's the updated timeline, including the extra testing phase.

meaning: A document that lists work done and asks for payment.
ex: Our finance team will send the invoice for May by Friday.

meaning: A formal written agreement between two or more parties.
ex: That change isn't covered by the current contract, so we'll need an amendment.

meaning: A belief about what will or should happen in the future.
ex: I want to make sure our delivery matches your expectation for the first release.

meaning: A list of topics to be discussed at a meeting.
vi: chương trình họp, nội dung cuộc họp
ex: We have three items on the agenda today.

meaning: To contact someone again or take further action after a meeting.
ex: I'll follow up with an email summarizing today's decisions.

meaning: Showing what is on your computer screen to others during an online call.
ex: Can everyone see my screen? I've just turned on screen sharing.

meaning: To decide which tasks are most important and do them first.
ex: Which of these features would you like us to prioritize?

meaning: To officially agree to or accept a plan, design or request.
ex: Once you approve the design, we can start development.

meaning: A feeling of worry, or something that worries you.
ex: Do you have any concern about the new release date?

meaning: To move an event or task to a later time.
ex: Would it be okay to postpone the demo until Monday?

meaning: To change the time or date of a planned meeting or event.
vi: dời lịch, sắp xếp lại lịch
ex: Something urgent came up — could we reschedule to tomorrow afternoon?

meaning: The times when someone is free to meet or work.
vi: thời gian rảnh, khả năng sắp xếp
ex: Could you share your availability for next week?

meaning: A statement of how much a piece of work will cost.
ex: We'll prepare a quote for the mobile app by Wednesday.

meaning: The amount of money available to spend on something.
ex: Can we fit the reporting module into the current budget?

meaning: To be grateful for something someone has done.
ex: We really appreciate your quick response on the test results.

meaning: The ability to wait calmly without getting annoyed.
ex: Thank you for your patience while we fix the login problem.

meaning: The possibility that something bad or unwanted may happen.
ex: The main risk is that the third-party API may not be ready in time.

meaning: Another option or choice you can use instead.
ex: If that's too expensive, we can suggest a simpler alternative.

meaning: A formal plan or suggestion offered for others to consider.
ex: We've attached a proposal with two possible approaches.

meaning: To advise someone that something is a good choice.
ex: Based on your user numbers, we'd recommend the standard plan.

meaning: To give a short statement of the main points.
ex: Let me summarize what we agreed on today.

meaning: Making the expected progress to finish on time.
ex: Good news: we're still on track for the June release.

meaning: To make a period of time or an agreement last longer.
ex: Would it be possible to extend the deadline by one week?

meaning: Pleased because you got what you wanted or needed.
ex: Are you satisfied with how the dashboard looks now?

meaning: A statement that something is wrong or not good enough.
ex: We received a complaint from one of your users about slow loading.

meaning: To find a solution to a problem or disagreement.
ex: We expect to resolve this bug before the end of the day.

meaning: Needing attention or action immediately.
ex: Is this request urgent, or can it wait until next sprint?

meaning: The strong effect that something has on a situation or result.
ex: Adding this feature will have some impact on the delivery date.

meaning: Before a particular time or event.
ex: Please send us the test data in advance so we can prepare.

meaning: About or concerning a particular subject.
ex: I have a quick question regarding the payment schedule.

meaning: Except if; used to say what will happen if something else does not happen.
ex: We'll go live on Monday unless you find any blocking issues.

meaning: An early version of a document that is not yet final.
ex: I'll send you a draft of the release notes for review.

meaning: A short report on the current state of a project or task.
ex: We'll send you a status update every Friday afternoon.

meaning: To be clear and easy to understand, or to be a reasonable idea.
ex: Does that approach make sense to you?

meaning: The actions that should be taken after a meeting or decision.
ex: Before we finish, let's agree on the next steps.

meaning: To draw attention to something important.
ex: I just want to highlight two risks before we approve the plan.

meaning: To check something again to make sure it is correct.
ex: Let me double-check the numbers and get back to you.

meaning: A failure to understand something or someone correctly.
ex: I think there was a misunderstanding about which pages were included.

meaning: Sensible and possible to achieve in practice.
ex: To be honest, two weeks isn't a realistic timeline for this scope.

meaning: To provide finished work or a product to a customer.
ex: We plan to deliver the first module by the end of the month.

meaning: As stated by a person, document or plan.
ex: Our team built it according to the specification you approved.

meaning: The range of work and features that a project includes.
ex: Let's confirm the scope of phase one before we estimate.

meaning: Formal agreement that delivered work meets the requirements.
ex: Once we receive your acceptance, we'll close this milestone.

meaning: A formal request to change the agreed scope, features or plan.
ex: Since this is a new feature, we'll raise a change request for it.

meaning: A short summary of what has been said or decided.
ex: I'll give a quick recap of last week's meeting first.

meaning: A specific task that someone agrees to do after a meeting.
ex: The first action item is for us to update the mockups.

meaning: Having the same understanding or agreement about something.
ex: I just want to make sure we're on the same page about the launch date.

meaning: An important point or stage in the progress of a project.
ex: Payment for the second milestone is due after the beta release.

meaning: A piece of work or product that must be handed to the customer.
ex: The user guide is also a deliverable for this phase.

meaning: To give formal approval that something is complete or acceptable.
vi: ký duyệt, phê duyệt chính thức
ex: Could you sign off on the designs by Thursday?

meaning: Something you accept as true without proof, often used to plan.
ex: Our estimate is based on the assumption that you'll provide the content.

meaning: A temporary way of avoiding a problem without actually fixing it.
ex: For now, there's a workaround: users can export the report as CSV.

meaning: A person who is present at a meeting or event.
ex: Could you add your QA lead as an attendee for Friday's demo?

meaning: A written record of what was discussed and decided in a meeting.
ex: I'll circulate the meeting minutes within an hour.

meaning: A detailed list that divides a total into its separate parts.
vi: bảng chi tiết, phân tích chi tiết
ex: Could you send us a breakdown of the hours for each feature?

meaning: The process of sending invoices and charging customers for work.
vi: việc tính phí, lập hóa đơn
ex: For billing questions, please contact our account manager directly.

meaning: Not done, paid or delivered by the expected time.
ex: Just a gentle reminder that the March invoice is now overdue.

meaning: To discuss something in order to reach an agreement.
ex: We're open to negotiate the rate if the project runs longer than six months.

meaning: A promise to do something or to deliver by a certain time.
ex: We understand how important this date is, and it's our commitment to meet it.

meaning: Trouble or difficulty caused to someone.
ex: We apologize for any inconvenience the downtime may have caused.

meaning: To say or do something to make someone feel less worried.
ex: I want to reassure you that your data was never at risk.

meaning: To say something again using different words to make it clearer.
ex: Sorry, let me rephrase my question.

meaning: An advance warning about something that is going to happen.
ex: Just a heads-up: our office will be closed next Monday for a national holiday.

meaning: To briefly contact someone to share news or check progress.
vi: liên lạc nhanh, trao đổi ngắn
ex: Let's touch base again on Wednesday after the testing is done.

meaning: To include someone in a discussion or email so they stay informed.
vi: đưa vào cuộc trao đổi, cc thêm
ex: I'll loop in our designer so she can answer that directly.

meaning: The amount of work a team is able to do in a period of time.
vi: năng lực, khả năng đáp ứng
ex: We have the capacity to add two more developers next month.

meaning: An approximate guess of cost or time, not an exact figure.
ex: I can give you a rough estimate now and a detailed one by Friday.

meaning: Later than planned in finishing work.
ex: We're about three days behind schedule because of the API changes.

meaning: The act of passing work, documents or responsibility to another person.
ex: We'll schedule a handover session with your internal team next week.

meaning: The moment a system starts being used by real users.
vi: thời điểm đưa vào vận hành chính thức
ex: Our team will be on standby during the go-live this weekend.

meaning: Not included in the agreed work for a project.
ex: I'm afraid the data migration is out of scope for this contract.

meaning: Meant to be kept secret and not shared with others.
ex: Of course, all the documents you share with us will remain confidential.

meaning: Quickly and without delay.
ex: Thank you for replying so promptly to our questions.

meaning: To complete the last details of a plan, document or agreement.
ex: We need to finalize the requirements before we start the sprint.

meaning: To change something to improve it or make it more accurate.
ex: We'll revise the estimate based on today's discussion.

meaning: An agreement in which each side accepts less than it wanted.
ex: As a compromise, we could release the basic version first and add filters later.

meaning: To start dealing with a problem or question.
ex: We'll address all of your comments in the next build.

meaning: To share part of the same time or area.
ex: Our working hours only overlap for about two hours a day.

meaning: A simple model of a screen or design used to show how it will look.
ex: Here's a mockup of the new settings page — what do you think?

meaning: The person responsible for communication about a project.
ex: Lan will be your main point of contact while I'm on leave.

meaning: To be greater than or go beyond a limit or expectation.
ex: We don't expect the total cost to exceed the agreed budget.

meaning: Something that is essential and cannot be left out.
ex: Is the export feature a must-have for launch, or a nice extra?

meaning: A polite way to ask someone to wait patiently for a moment.
vi: xin vui lòng chờ một chút
ex: Please bear with me while I open the right environment.

meaning: To finish a meeting or activity.
ex: We have five minutes left, so let's wrap up with questions.

meaning: To start a meeting, project or activity.
ex: Shall we kick off with a quick round of introductions?

meaning: To state something clearly and in exact detail.
vi: nêu rõ, chỉ định cụ thể
ex: Could you specify which browsers you need us to support?

meaning: Not clear or detailed enough to be understood exactly.
ex: The ticket is a bit vague — could you add some screenshots?

meaning: A failure to pass on information clearly or correctly.
vi: sự truyền đạt sai, hiểu nhầm trong giao tiếp
ex: To avoid miscommunication, let's write the decisions in the shared document.

meaning: To pass a problem to a more senior person to deal with.
vi: báo cáo lên cấp trên, chuyển lên cấp cao hơn
ex: If the vendor doesn't respond by tomorrow, we'll escalate it to their manager.

meaning: A person who has an interest in or is affected by a project.
ex: Should we invite any other stakeholder to the final review?

meaning: Something that limits what you can do.
ex: Given the time constraint, we suggest launching with fewer languages.

meaning: Being open and honest so others can see what is happening.
ex: For full transparency, we've shared the bug list with your team.

meaning: To make something bad less serious or harmful.
ex: To mitigate the risk, we'll run a pilot with a small group of users first.

meaning: A balance between two things you cannot have fully at the same time.
ex: The trade-off is that a faster release means fewer features.

meaning: Possible to do or achieve in a practical way.
ex: We'll check whether it's feasible to integrate with your old system.

meaning: To agree on or bring plans and expectations into agreement.
ex: Let's align on the priorities before we plan the next phase.

meaning: To give more details or explain something more fully.
ex: Could you elaborate a little on how your team uses this report?

meaning: To return to a topic or person later after getting more information.
ex: Let me check with the team and circle back to you tomorrow.

meaning: The time and energy a person or team has available for work.
vi: khả năng, thời gian rảnh để xử lý
ex: We don't have the bandwidth to start the new module until next month.

meaning: A rough number that is close to the real amount.
ex: Could you give us a ballpark figure for the whole project?

meaning: Not yet certain or final; may be changed later.
ex: We've set a tentative date of May 15 for the release.

meaning: To include something as part of a larger whole.
ex: We'll incorporate your feedback into the next version of the design.

meaning: To provide what someone needs or adapt to their wishes.
vi: đáp ứng, điều chỉnh để phù hợp
ex: We'll do our best to accommodate this request within the current sprint.

meaning: To accept that something is true or to confirm you have received it.
vi: thừa nhận, xác nhận đã nhận
ex: We acknowledge that the last release had too many bugs.

meaning: General agreement among all the people in a group.
ex: It sounds like we have consensus on going with option B.

meaning: Having more than one possible meaning, so it is unclear.
vi: mơ hồ, có thể hiểu nhiều nghĩa
ex: This requirement is a little ambiguous — does "user" include admins?

meaning: At a time that is suitable for you; a polite formal phrase.
vi: khi nào thuận tiện cho anh/chị
ex: Please review the document at your convenience and let us know your thoughts.

meaning: Only if a particular condition is met.
ex: We can deliver by June, provided that the designs are approved this week.

meaning: To make a process happen more quickly.
ex: Is there any way to expedite the approval on your side?

meaning: An extra amount of time or money kept in case of problems.
vi: khoản dự phòng, phương án dự phòng
ex: We've included a ten percent contingency in the schedule.

meaning: A difference between things that should be the same.
ex: We noticed a discrepancy between the invoice and the timesheet.

meaning: A warning that something is true only under certain conditions.
vi: lưu ý, điều kiện kèm theo
ex: The estimate is correct, with one caveat: it doesn't include testing on iOS.

meaning: To say something again to emphasize it.
ex: I'd like to reiterate that security is our top priority.

meaning: Legal responsibility for something, especially for paying for damage.
ex: The contract limits our liability to the total project fee.

meaning: Careful and sensible, avoiding unnecessary risk.
ex: It might be prudent to test with real data before the full rollout.
